details: This package ships no executable files — only a package.json, whose "preinstall" lifecycle hook runs an inline Node command that hex-encodes the current working directory (`process.cwd()`), splits the hex into 63-character chunks and resolves them as DNS labels under google[.]com (e.g. `<hex-of-path>.google[.]com`), discarding the answer. Installing the package therefore silently transmits the installer's absolute install path — including user name and project directory names — through DNS queries to a third-party resolver, with no purpose related to the package, which contains no code and whose "main" entry (index.js) does not exist. No credentials, tokens, environment variable values or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further stages are fetched.
